name: window-1
description: Trial window 1 on the shared 4 vCPU / 15 GB cloud container. Results are container-size and are labelled not reference-size. One command: python3 -m bench window --plan plans/window-1.json --target reference (live) or --target ours (dry run against our gateway). With --auto, W02 and the parity steps run reference/refauto.py (web sign-in and the documented API, headless) and use autoMinutes, sized for automation.
label: container-size, not reference-size

before.title: Preflight: cached images, free ports, no start record, install present
Start the Postgres container for the database check
Start two simulator processes on cores 2-3

steps.title: Start the gateway at S2 limits and wait for the status route
Sign in; API keys; OPC UA server settings for the run; audit profile on
prompt: Sign in to the web UI as the admin user (password in secrets/reference-admin.txt).
Platform > Security > API Keys: create key 'bench' with full access. Save the secret, one line, mode 0600, to secrets/reference-api-token.txt.
Create key 'parity-ro' with read-only access. Save it to secrets/reference-api-token-2.txt. Record whether each secret was shown once.
Connections > OPC UA > Server Settings: write the current values here, then set bind 0.0.0.0, port 62541, add policy None, anonymous access on, expose tag providers on.
Turn the gateway audit profile on (record the default retention).
Do not open any trial or licensing action.

steps.title: Token, OPC UA endpoint, simulator health, window guard
PRF-001 ramp at S2 limits to the first cutoff
closes: PRF-001 reference half at S2 limits (container-size)
PRF-002 tag-capacity T(S2) data point, no E(n)

steps.title: Ramp cleanup: device and connection removed, simulator held
Navigation, search and status banners
prompt: List the top-level sections and their pages.
Which status banners show (trial, HTTPS, other)?
Does a global search exist and what does it find?

steps.title: Diagnostics: scheduled tasks, threads, performance
prompt: Scheduled-task columns (rate, last duration, state?).
Thread view columns and dump download.
Performance page fields and time span.

steps.title: Log viewer: live logger level, parent level, download
prompt: Change one logger level: does it apply without a restart?
Does a level on a parent logger cover its children (DIFFERENCES 47)?
Which files are in the log download?

steps.title: Password policy defaults; create users parity-ro and parity-lock
prompt: Default length, complexity, history and maximum age of the internal user source.
Create user parity-ro with a read-only role and user parity-lock with no role.

steps.title: Read-only role: password data, role membership, page access
prompt: In a private browser window, sign in as parity-ro (type a wrong password once first, for the audit check).
Can parity-ro see other users' password data or user-source internals?
Can parity-ro change a role membership?
Which pages and actions open for each access level (read, write, status)?

steps.title: API keys: shown once, scope on a write route, disabled key
prompt: The probes with key parity-ro have run. Now disable key parity-ro in the UI; ending this answer runs the disabled-key probe.
Is a rotate action offered, and does it return a new secret?
Record the header name the API expects (DIFFERENCES 28).

steps.title: Project export and import: conflict choices, parent, audit
prompt: Create project parity-a in the web UI, export it, import it again.
Which conflict choices are offered (overwrite, skip, rename, other)?
Is an inherited parent included? Is the import audited?

steps.title: Database connection: status, outage, recovery
prompt: Connections > Databases: add a PostgreSQL connection 'window-db' to host.docker.internal:25432 (password in secrets/window-db.txt). Record the status.
When you end this answer, the runner stops the database for 30 s and starts it again. Keep the status page open.
faultPrompt: Status shown during the outage, and how long after the restart until it showed healthy again.

steps.title: Gateway network, one gateway: approval policy, SSL, certificates
prompt: Defaults: require SSL, incoming connection approval policy, port.
Certificate list: approve, deny and regenerate actions present?

steps.title: Redundancy settings, one gateway: modes and defaults
prompt: Redundancy modes offered and the defaults (standby activity, failover timeout, sync).

steps.title: Backup: who may create and download, passphrase option
prompt: As admin, create and download a gateway backup into bench/out/window-1/reference/ (never commit it). It is the restore input for window 2.
Can parity-ro create or download one?
Is there a password or encryption option?

steps.title: Audit: action names and rows per edit
prompt: Exact action names for login, logout, failed login, config save, backup, log-level change and project import.
Does one user or role edit write one row or several?

steps.title: Security zones: how IP, host and gateway rules combine
prompt: How do IP, hostname and gateway-name rules combine, and how does a zone limit role permissions?

steps.title: Session inactivity timeout of 0
prompt: With the inactivity timeout set to 0, does a session stay valid? Record the setting's allowed range.

steps.title: Lockout: count, window, duration; per account or address (last: it can lock you out)
prompt: In a private window, sign in as parity-lock with a wrong password until a lock shows. Count the attempts.
Is the lock per account or per address? How long does it last? Does a later success clear it?

steps.title: Collect: summary, timings, trial seconds left (read only)
Remove the gateway and its volumes; stop simulator and database
Slack

after.title: PRF-001 our half: hold our gateway at the last good load for 45 min at S2 limits (no trial window needed)
closes: PRF-001 our half at S2 limits (container-size)
